fonts.display: 'ES Allianz', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'ES Allianz', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary action buttons on light surfaces, body text, headlines, card borders — the universal ink of the system

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas on light sections, card surfaces, text on dark backgrounds, button text on filled buttons

palette.name: Deep Teal
palette.role: Dark section backgrounds — the only large chromatic surface, used for narrative bands between editorial spreads

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Card surfaces and hairline borders on light sections — the warm off-white that prevents starkness

palette.name: Sandstone
palette.role: Warm card surface tint, section backgrounds in cream/peach areas — desert-hour warmth

palette.name: Ash Blush
palette.role: Soft warm card surface, secondary peach accent on portrait cards

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Muted neutral footer and section dividers — warm mid-gray grounding color

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Button and link background tint, card surface for outlined controls

palette.name: Pewter
palette.role: Disabled or tertiary button fills, secondary surface fills

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Near-black for dark button fills on light surfaces where pure black feels too harsh

palette.name: Dusty Sky
palette.role: Soft blue pastel — feature card background, decorative portrait card tint

palette.name: Mist Mint
palette.role: Pale mint-teal pastel — feature card background variant

palette.name: Wisteria
palette.role: Lavender pastel — feature card background variant

palette.name: Desert Clay
palette.role: Warm peach/tan pastel — feature card background variant, ties to hero photography palette

palette.name: Slate Teal
palette.role: Muted blue-teal for feature tag pills on dark sections, badge backgrounds — the only repetitive chromatic UI element

palette.name: Saddle Brown
palette.role: Warm brown for badge borders and occasional accent text — echoes the terrain photography
